column3: “Chosen” renders ἐκλεκτῇ (“elect”); BSB adds “the” before “truth” (“in truth”).
BSB follows the critical text with “from Jesus Christ” (no “Lord”); the Textus Receptus has “the Lord Jesus Christ.”
“Overjoyed” renders “I rejoiced exceedingly”; “just as the Father has commanded us” recasts “even as we received a commandment from the Father.”
BSB adds “dear” before “lady” and leaves out “I am writing” (γράφων).
BSB ends with “that you must walk in love”; the Greek has “that you may walk in it.” BSB also adds “very” before “commandment.”

BSB follows the critical text with “have gone out” (the Textus Receptus has “have entered”). “Refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh” recasts “those not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh”; “Any such person is” renders “This is.”
BSB follows the critical text with “you” (“you do not lose … you may be fully rewarded”); the Textus Receptus has “we.” “Be fully rewarded” renders “receive a full reward.”
BSB follows the critical text with “runs ahead” (the Textus Receptus has “transgresses”) and with “His teaching” in the second clause, where the Textus Receptus has “the teaching of Christ.”
“Into your home” renders “into [the] house”; “or even greet him” renders “do not tell him to rejoice.”
“Greets” renders λέγων (“tells to rejoice”); “such a person” renders “him.”
“I would prefer not to do so” renders “I did not purpose”; “face to face” renders “mouth to mouth.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “Amen”; it is in the Textus Receptus. “Send you greetings” renders “greet you.”
